title: How Casey Adams went from a neck injury to a top-200 business podcast and an events company
summary: A 2019 local profile of Casey Adams, who built a personal brand, the Rise of The Young podcast and the Build Your Empire events company as a teenager. He shares what he learned about time, saying no, relationships and bringing people together.

principles.text: Learn when to say NO to opportunities; entrepreneurs get flooded with them.
principles.quote: As an entrepreneur, you’re introduced to so many opportunities and learning to say NO has truly impacted my life.

principles.text: Know when to distance yourself from people and move on from a situation.
principles.quote: You must know when to let go, and when to move on from a situation or an individual.

principles.text: Bringing people together through events is powerful leverage.
principles.quote: After throwing dozens of business events all across the world, one of the biggest things I’ve learned is that there is power in bringing people together.

principles.text: Interviewing influential people teaches listening, which underpins real relationships.
principles.quote: Being able to interview such impactful people at 18 years old has truly given me insight into the power of listening.

principles.text: How you position yourself online is a source of power; build a personal brand.
principles.quote: After traveling all of the world speaking on stages about personal branding, I’ve realized that we have so much power by the way we position ourselves online.

principles.text: A support system of people who care is the most important asset.
principles.quote: Having a support system of people who truly care about you is the most important asset I have, and I attribute that to luck.
